description: DER-Fault: A Dataset for Fault Analysis in DER-Integrated Distribution Systems is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Fathima Razeeya Mohamed Razick, Petr Musilek (University of Alberta). This dataset contains simulated electrical measurements for short-circuit fault analysis in the Iowa 240-bus distribution system [1] under different loading and distributed energy resource (DER) integration conditions. The dataset can be used for studies on fault detection, classification, localization, and data-driven distribution system monitoring. The dataset was generated using OpenDSS. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
